desc: Prove the monotonicity property after sorting `A`, `B`, and `C` descending, including why positivity is required.
Design the max-heap state representation: store negative value plus the three indices, and compute `A[i]*B[j] + B[j]*C[k] + C[k]*A[i]`.
Specify neighbor generation for `(i+1,j,k)`, `(i,j+1,k)`, and `(i,j,k+1)`, with bounds checks and duplicate prevention through a visited set.
Analyze complexity, showing that at most `O(K)` states are popped and `O(3K)` are considered, for `O(K log K + N log N)` time and `O(K)` extra memory.
Implement robust stdin/stdout handling using Python integers, run the heap traversal, and validate against samples.
